nodes.label: danet deploy command
nodes.rationale: Bundles the project (default entrypoint run.ts into bundle.js) and hands the bundle to deployctl, so deploying is a single command.

nodes.label: danet develop command
nodes.rationale: Runs the project with file watching, as opposed to `danet start` which runs without watching.

nodes.label: jsr:@danet/cli package
nodes.rationale: Installed globally under the shortened name `danet` for simplicity, though any install name works.

nodes.label: Danet CLI
nodes.rationale: A CLI that initializes Danet applications and will grow to cover scaffolding, dev serving, and production bundling; it embodies best-practice architectural patterns to encourage well-structured apps.

nodes.label: OIDC id-token write permission
nodes.rationale: id-token: write is granted so `deno publish` can authenticate to JSR via GitHub OIDC instead of a long-lived token; contents stays read-only to keep the publish job least-privileged.

nodes.label: Database provider selection
nodes.rationale: `danet new` interactively asks for mongodb, postgres or in-memory and generates the matching code, leaving only environment variables for the user. Non-interactive flags (--mongodb, --postgres, --in-memory) exist so the prompt can be bypassed in scripted or CI usage.

nodes.label: danet generate command
nodes.rationale: Aliased as `g` and modeled deliberately on the NestJS CLI so users coming from Nest find a familiar scaffolding workflow.

nodes.label: --skip-import option
nodes.rationale: Escape hatch for users who want to control module registration themselves.

nodes.label: Automatic module wiring
nodes.rationale: Generated components are registered automatically (controller into `controllers`, service into `injectables`, module into the root app module `imports`) so the user never has to hand-edit the module after scaffolding. Wiring fails silently rather than erroring when the target module file is missing, so generation still succeeds outside a conventional project layout.

nodes.label: Danet folder convention
nodes.rationale: Each component lives in its own folder `src/<name>/`; names are normalized so kebab-case, camelCase and PascalCase inputs all converge on the same folder and PascalCase class name, keeping generated projects consistent regardless of how the user types the name.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: The graph is preferred over raw grep or the full GRAPH_REPORT.md because query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph, which is far smaller in context than raw source browsing.

nodes.label: graphify update
nodes.rationale: Run after modifying code to keep the graph current; it is AST-only so it incurs no API cost.

nodes.label: GRAPH_REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Reserved for broad architecture review only, because reading it costs far more context than a scoped query result.

nodes.label: graphify wiki index
nodes.rationale: Preferred for broad navigation over raw source browsing when it exists.
